ASSIGNMENT: Build an Advanced Document Q&A RAG System with Multi-Agent
Architecture
OVERVIEW:
Create a sophisticated RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) application were users
upload documents (text/PDF), builds a knowledge base and then query the content. The
system uses a multi-agent architecture with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration
to retrieve relevant info, perform web searches when needed, and generate accurate
answers using an LLM.
MUST USE: LangGraph for agent orchestration
CORE REQUIREMENTS
1. MULTI-AGENT ARCHITECTURE
Implement a coordinated multi-agent system with the following agents:
Orchestrator Agent, Query Analysis Agent, Retrieval Agent, Re-ranking Agent,
Generation Agent, Citation Agent
2. MCP (MODEL CONTEXT PROTOCOL) INTEGRATION
Required MCP Servers:
- Web Search MCP Server, Vector Database MCP Server, Document Processing MCP
Server (Optional but Recommended)

3. DOCUMENT PROCESSING
- Accept text files (.txt, .md) and PDFs
- Extract text content accurately
- Support image extraction from PDFs with OCR
- Chunk documents intelligently (consider semantic boundaries)
- Generate embeddings for all chunks
- Preserve document metadata (filename, page numbers, timestamps)

4. HYBRID SEARCH IMPLEMENTATION
5. CONVERSATION MEMORY & HISTORY
- Implement conversation history tracking
- Enable follow-up questions with context awareness
- Store conversation turns in memory
- Use conversation buffer or summary memory
- Allow users to reference previous questions/answers
6. BACKEND & FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE
Backend (Fast API):
- Build RESTful API using Fast API
- Appropriate Endpoints as required
Frontend (HTML/CSS/JavaScript):
- Build single-page application using vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- No frameworks required (React, Vue, etc.) - pure HTML/CSS/JS only
- Can use simple libraries like Bootstrap for styling (optional)
DELIVERABLES
1. Source code repository
2. Documentation
3. Demo:
- Sample documents for testing
- Example queries demonstrating key features
